subject.title: [Bug]: Inbound message not delivered to idle claude-stdio warm process; session sits 'done' until no-output watchdog (600s) respawns it (WhatsApp, macOS, 2026.6.1-beta.1)

question: Is the deterministic dormant-follow-up drain fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95039 sufficient to close this warm `claude-stdio` WhatsApp report without a current-main live reproduction?
rationale: The adjacent fix is real and shipped in the checked release tag, but the issue specifically reports an alive warm Claude process and no-output watchdog recovery, and no source test or live run proves that exact post-idle path now wakes correctly.

options.title: Keep Open For Live Proof
options.body: Require a current-main WhatsApp or equivalent `claude-stdio` post-idle run showing the first queued inbound message starts a turn without watchdog respawn before closing.

options.title: Close As Covered By Queue Fix
options.body: Treat the report as the same root cause as the merged dormant follow-up drain race and close it with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95039 plus v2026.6.11 provenance.

options.title: Split Remaining Scheduler Work
options.body: Close only if the warm-process path is verified fixed and move any remaining background-agent fairness concern to the broader scheduler reports.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Live Proof
recommendation.body: Require a current-main WhatsApp or equivalent `claude-stdio` post-idle run showing the first queued inbound message starts a turn without watchdog respawn before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored the merged adjacent fix and has the clearest recent ownership of the reply queue handoff being used as possible close evidence.
